entries.t: <FACE:7D>What is it-robo?<NL><WAIT>A letter from Sea Boss<NL>Sekiran-robo!
<FACE:80>Sekiran runs the Block<NL>right next door-robo!<WAIT>At last, even dropout<NL><WAIT>grunts like us get to<NL>be Bosses-robo!
<FACE:7D>Uhh, what's it say?<NL><WAIT>"Dear esteemed members<NL> of the next Block…"
<FACE:7D>We're on a roll-robo!<NL>A real roll-roboo!!<WAIT>Keep reading-robo!<NL>
<FACE:57>"You lot are too loud!<NL><WAIT> Robo-robo till late<NL> I hear it next door!<WAIT> I sleep early for my<NL> complexion, got it!<WAIT> Not one more word!<NL> Don't even breathe!"
<FACE:7D>Heh heh… what a relief<NL>to lose! Bye-roboo!
